title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy levels E in terms of n, p_z, H_0, e, and m.

title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must present the correct form of the wave function psi(x) including the normalization constant and the Hermite polynomials.

title: Use of Schrödinger Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Schrödinger equation to derive the energy levels and wave functions.

title: Degeneracy Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the degeneracy of the energy levels due to the arbitrary nature of p_y.

title: Correct Eigenfunction Form
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the form of the eigenfunctions and their dependence on the parameters involved.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the energy expression and wave function derivation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure all necessary constants and factors are included in the final expressions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that could simplify the problem.
